text:
Mia Nguyen: quick heads-up — onboading of boreas-32k-quant finished this morning. doing a KV-snapshot interpolation sweep; seeing token misalignment / mild hallucinations starting ~28k tokens when switching between fp16 and int8 backends. not confident if this is ropescale or kv-indexing drift.
Samir Patel: can you paste a small repro prompt that triggers the drift?
Mia Nguyen: yes — long legal contract concatenation. i'll share a sanitized snippet. repro is flaky but consistent under quantized runner.
Alex K: which quant profile did you try? int8-ffn-only or channelwise? also which ropescale mode (legacy / rescale2)?
Mia Nguyen: int8-channelwise, rescale2. baseline (fp16) is clean. int8 gives subtle token shift around the 27984..28020 range.
Toni Ops: @Mia Nguyen assign a job id and run the standard longctx-kv harness so we can capture traces. attach `ci-bot` so tracing artifacts are uploaded.
Mia Nguyen: job 20260318-boreas-kv-01. running now with:
```
./run_longctx_test.sh --model boreas-32k-quant --quant-profile channelwise --ropescale rescale2 --prompt-file ./tests/long_legal_snippet.txt --capture-kv --job-id 20260318-boreas-kv-01
```
Mia Nguyen: quick paste of the failing segment from logs:
```
[2026-03-18T09:12:05Z] KV-TRACE: prefill idx=27970 len=300 window-start=27680 window-end=28079
[2026-03-18T09:12:05Z] KV-MAP: wrote shard=3 offset=2304 rk=0x7f12a3
[2026-03-18T09:12:05Z] INFER(INT8): token 27996 predicted=\"Section\" prob=0.87
[2026-03-18T09:12:05Z] INFER(FP16): token 27996 predicted=\"Sec\" prob=0.91
[2026-03-18T09:12:05Z] DIFF: token-stream divergence at global-index=27996 -> downstream shift +2 tokens
```
Samir Patel: interesting — the diff shows a prefix-level divergence at that index rather than immediate corruption. could be a RoPE phase mismatch during sparse-prefill.
Eva R: did you try toggling `prefill_stride` or `kv-align` flags? earlier we saw off-by-two when stride != window tile size.
Mia Nguyen: yes. toggling `prefill_stride` from 64->128 changed where the divergence occurs but did not eliminate it. `kv-align=true` reduced frequency but one case still reproduces.
Alex K: can you dump the rotary matrices around that token? need to see if rescale2 introduces rounding error in int8 path.
Mia Nguyen: attached in artifact (ci-bot uploaded to /artifacts/20260318/20260318-boreas-kv-01/rotary-dumps.tar.gz) — can you check numeric deltas between fp16 and dequantized int8?
Toni Ops: also note that on the dedicated cluster we had a memcopy micro-reorder in shard joins last week — that caused index-stable races. but manifested differently. worth ruling out infra.
Samir Patel: quick idea: run a hybrid run where lower layers use fp16 and upper layers int8 to localize. if divergence occurs only after a certain layer, that points to quant rounding cascade.
Mia Nguyen: ran hybrid (layers 0..16 fp16, 17..n int8). divergence moved earlier by ~120 tokens -> points to cumulative kv-attenuation.
Alex K: can you try re-run with `rotary_interpolate=true` patch I pushed to branch `rotary-fix/2026-03-17`? it forces a consistent rescale factor across quant/dequant boundary.
Mia Nguyen: testing branch now. re-run command:
```
./run_longctx_test.sh --model boreas-32k-quant --quant-profile channelwise --ropescale rescale2 --rotary-interpolate true --capture-kv --job-id 20260318-boreas-kv-02
```
ci-bot: artifact upload started for job 20260318-boreas-kv-02 -> s3://redwood-ci/20260318-boreas-kv-02/
Samir Patel: nice, thanks. if that fixes it we should add a regression test covering the 28k boundary and include a seed prompt from the legal corpus.
Eva R: also please run a pairwise LM-eval for fluency on 1k token windows (non-overlapping) comparing fp16 vs int8 with the new rotary interpolation — want to ensure no perf regressions.
Mia Nguyen: will run eval sweep overnight. preliminary: rotary-interpolate reduced divergence count from 6/10 runs -> 1/10 runs. still not zero.
Toni Ops: filing a quick ticket for infra check too: INFRA-6214 (possible shard-join reorder). linking to job artifacts.
Alex K: if we still see residual flakiness, add a small kv-checksum (rolling checksum per 1024-token tile) into the runtime to catch where the first mismatch happens. that will help triage to exact layer/op.
Mia Nguyen: good plan. adding checksum instrument and re-running tomorrow. thanks all. :thumbsup:
Samir Patel: ping me once checksums exist, i'll triage deltas.
Mia Nguyen: will do — attaching short summary once CI finishes.
ci-bot: job 20260318-boreas-kv-02 completed, artifacts uploaded.
Mia Nguyen: final note — observed that when switching to `rescale1` mode the divergence disappears but latency increases by ~7%. probably a tradeoff for now. decisions needed on quality vs latency for the hosted profile.
Alex K: opened PR with `rotary-interpolate` into staging, added unit tests. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/842
Eva R: +1 on adding the 28k boundary regression test to the onboarding checklist.
Mia Nguyen: thanks everyone, closing this thread until further repros.
